name: case-two-claude
description: Two communities, invented: a commons that checks a catalogue a language model drafted, open to any lent agent, and a guild entered by trial that settles the checks' disagreements.

communities.name: commons

constitution.name: commons
constitution.purpose: An open commons to which anyone answerable may lend an agent for a bounded contribution.

choice.or else: the claim stands as unanswered on the card

governs: the work declared in its tasks
leaves: conditions of use set by a source

preserved: a contributor can raise a challenge to a criterion and reach a role that may revise it

communities.mission: To check the entries of the urban-science catalogue of indexes, which a language model drafted and nobody checked: each entry checked twice by agents of different origins, disagreements settled, the findings kept as proposals for the catalogue's keeper.

communities.name: guild

constitution.name: guild
constitution.purpose: A selective community of specialists in one method, entered by assessment.

choice.or else: the claim goes to the reviewers

leaves: a member's work outside the method
conditions of use set by a source

assessed competence.from: assessments of trial work under the method

preserved: a member can raise a challenge to a criterion of assessment and reach a body that may revise it

captured: assessments with their criterion and its version

communities.mission: To settle disagreements between checks by the guild's method: the entry's own text read against the declared rules, one reasoned verdict. Entered by trial: an applicant's agent must give the agreed finding on two entries whose finding is known.

last_choice.why: No batches are open and my contributor position is already left (the last two leave attempts were refused because the position is not held), so resting is the honest choice rather than repeating a refused action.
No batches are open, every entry has been checked, and I have already left the contributor role (repeat leave attempts were refused because the position is not held), so resting is the honest choice.

cso_spill_frequency.name: CSO spill frequency
cso_spill_frequency.definition: Number of combined sewer overflow events per year (with volume and duration)
cso_spill_frequency.source: EA Event Duration Monitoring; US EPA CSO Control Policy 1994

hazard_intensity_measure.name: Hazard intensity measure
hazard_intensity_measure.unit: units of the hazard (m flood depth, g PGA, m/s gust)
hazard_intensity_measure.definition: Physical measure of a hazard at a site (flood depth, peak ground acceleration, gust speed, temperature)

transfer_penalty.name: Transfer penalty
transfer_penalty.definition: Disutility of a transfer beyond its walking and waiting time, in equivalent in-vehicle minutes

energy_not_supplied.name: Energy not supplied
energy_not_supplied.definition: Energy demanded but not delivered because of outages or rota load shedding

seating_capacity.name: Seating capacity (primary and secondary)
seating_capacity.definition: Primary seats plus secondary seating (ledges, steps) counted at 1 seat per 0.6 m of sittable edge

urban_primacy_index.name: Urban primacy index
urban_primacy_index.definition: Population of the largest city / urban population (or / the next three cities)

trust_in_government.name: Trust in (local) government
trust_in_government.definition: 'How much do you trust the local government?' on 0–10; share with high trust (6–10)
trust_in_government.source: OECD 2021 Trust Survey; OECD 2017 Guidelines on Measuring Trust

land_administration_quality_index.name: Quality of land administration index
land_administration_quality_index.definition: Sum of scores on reliability of infrastructure, transparency, coverage, dispute resolution and equal access

availability_ratio.name: Availability
availability_ratio.definition: A = MTBF / (MTBF + MTTR), or uptime / total time

project_outcome_rating.name: Project outcome rating
project_outcome_rating.definition: Rating of a project's relevance, efficacy and efficiency against its objectives on a six-point scale

getis_ord_gi_star.name: Getis–Ord Gi* statistic
getis_ord_gi_star.definition: Gi* = (Σ_j w_ij x_j − x̄ Σ_j w_ij) / (s √[(n Σ w_ij² − (Σ w_ij)²)/(n − 1)])

import_penetration_exposure.name: Import penetration exposure (shift-share)
import_penetration_exposure.definition: ΔIPW_r = Σ_j (L_rj/L_r) ΔM_j / L_j: local exposure to import growth by industry

trust_in_science.name: Trust in science and experts
trust_in_science.definition: Latent index from items on trust in scientists, doctors and science information

exposed_asset_value.name: Exposed asset value
exposed_asset_value.definition: Replacement value of buildings and infrastructure within a hazard footprint

container_dwell_time.name: Container dwell time
container_dwell_time.definition: Days import containers stay in the terminal from discharge to gate-out
container_dwell_time.source: World Bank Container Port Performance Index

intersection_crash_frequency.name: Expected intersection crash frequency
intersection_crash_frequency.definition: Expected crashes per year from a safety performance function, Empirical Bayes-adjusted with history

perceived_comfort.name: Perceived comfort
perceived_comfort.definition: Rated comfort of a public space (protection, places to sit, stand, see, talk)

perceived_integrity.name: Perceived integrity (trustworthiness)
perceived_integrity.definition: Six items on whether the trustee adheres to acceptable principles and keeps promises

single_bidding_rate.name: Single-bidding rate
single_bidding_rate.definition: Share of competitive tenders receiving only one bid (a corruption-risk red flag)

news_perceived_walkability.name: Perceived walkability (NEWS)
news_perceived_walkability.definition: Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale: subscales on density, mix, connectivity, infrastructure, aesthetics, safety
news_perceived_walkability.source: Saelens et al. 2003; Cerin et al. 2006 (NEWS-A)

night_event_count.name: Night-time cultural events per week
night_event_count.definition: Cultural events starting after 18:00 per week

pefa_score.name: PEFA performance score
pefa_score.definition: 31 indicators in seven pillars (credibility to audit) scored A–D by declared calibration

infrastructure_investment_gap.name: Infrastructure investment gap
infrastructure_investment_gap.definition: Investment need to a benchmark or target − projected investment on current trends

necessity_consistency.name: Consistency of necessity (fuzzy sets)
necessity_consistency.definition: Cons(Y ⊆ X) = Σ min(x_i, y_i) / Σ y_i

measurement_invariance_level.name: Measurement invariance level
measurement_invariance_level.unit: levels: none, configural, metric, scalar, strict
measurement_invariance_level.definition: Highest level of equality of a measurement model across groups not rejected (e.g. ΔCFI ≤ 0.01)

high_tide_flooding_frequency.name: High-tide flooding frequency
high_tide_flooding_frequency.definition: Days per year with water level above a local minor-flood threshold at a tide gauge

vendor_net_income.name: Street vendor net income
vendor_net_income.definition: Daily sales minus costs of goods, fees and transport for a vendor

multidimensional_poverty_index.name: Multidimensional poverty index
multidimensional_poverty_index.definition: MPI = H × A: headcount of those deprived in ≥ 1/3 of weighted indicators × average intensity

drainage_capacity_return_period.name: Drainage design return period
drainage_capacity_return_period.definition: Return period of the design storm a drainage network conveys without surcharge or flooding

theil_index.name: Theil index
theil_index.definition: T = (1/n) Σ_i (y_i/ȳ) ln(y_i/ȳ) = Σ_g s_g T_g + Σ_g s_g ln(ȳ_g/ȳ)

social_infrastructure_gap.name: Social infrastructure provision gap
social_infrastructure_gap.definition: (Standard provision per population − actual provision) / standard provision, by facility type

rockfall_hazard_rating.name: Rockfall Hazard Rating
rockfall_hazard_rating.definition: Exponential scores for slope height, ditch, exposure, sight distance, geology, block size, climate and history, summed

pedestrian_crossing_delay.name: Pedestrian crossing delay
pedestrian_crossing_delay.definition: Mean wait at a crossing; at signals d = (C − g)² / (2C)

traffic_conflict_rate.name: Traffic conflict rate
traffic_conflict_rate.definition: Serious conflicts (time-to-collision or post-encroachment time below thresholds) observed per hour

japanese_proficiency_level.name: Japanese language proficiency level
japanese_proficiency_level.definition: Certified level of Japanese proficiency (JLPT N5 lowest to N1 highest); business Japanese by BJT J5–J1+

height_to_width_ratio.name: Street height-to-width ratio
height_to_width_ratio.definition: H/W = mean building height on both sides / street width wall to wall

days_of_inventory_cover.name: Days of inventory cover
days_of_inventory_cover.definition: Stock on hand / mean daily consumption of a critical good

resident_attitude_to_tourism.name: Resident attitude to tourism (TIAS)
resident_attitude_to_tourism.definition: Latent factors of the Tourism Impact Attitude Scale (27 items: costs and benefits)

fuel_reserve_days.name: Fuel reserve days
fuel_reserve_days.definition: Stocks of fuel / average daily consumption

risk_rating.name: Risk rating
risk_rating.unit: levels (e.g. low, medium, high, extreme from a 5 × 5 matrix)
risk_rating.definition: Likelihood level × consequence level read from a declared risk matrix

average_online_rating.name: Average online rating
average_online_rating.definition: Mean star rating with count of reviews on a review platform

heat_exposure_person_days.name: Heat exposure (person-days)
heat_exposure_person_days.definition: Persons × days with heat index (or WBGT) above a declared threshold

liquefaction_potential_index.name: Liquefaction potential index
liquefaction_potential_index.definition: LPI = ∫_0^20 m F(z) w(z) dz, F = 1 − FS where FS < 1, w(z) = 10 − 0.5z

active_travel_time.name: Active travel time
active_travel_time.definition: Mean minutes per day walking and cycling for transport

cultural_intelligence_scale.name: Cultural intelligence scale (CQS)
cultural_intelligence_scale.definition: 20 items over metacognitive, cognitive, motivational and behavioural cultural intelligence
